title: Optional per-case input paths in the system source key
goal: A system case that declares its paths is invalidated only by changes inside them
acceptance: A case may declare input paths in evals/gauntlet/system-v1.json; undeclared cases keep the whole-tree key
A test shows a change inside a declared path makes the case pending and a change outside does not
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change to what the ledger counts as covered goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13 in the architecture reassessment. Not a measurement.
